Vinyl Album Project Zomboid - Finally Calm
Enable verbose [TMDBG] / [HIFIDBG] logs for diagnosing vehicle/world music that toggles on but produces no sound.

Chance (%) that a loose CD spawns clean and undamaged. CDs found in CD cases are always clean. Scratched CDs are labeled and skip tracks: 25% scratched skips every 2nd song, 50% skips all but one song, 100% skips everything and won't loop.
Spawn rate for CD albums from detected CD packs (0-100000%). 0=Disabled, 100=Normal.
Spawn rate for cassette tapes (0-100000%). 0=Disabled, 100=Normal. Multiplies with legacy cassette pack rates.
Allow players to disassemble cassettes and electronics (walkman, boombox, vinyl player) for parts. Disable to prevent disassembly entirely.
When new music packs are added to an existing save, sprinkle their media into already-generated containers as chunks load. Off = new packs only appear in freshly-generated loot.

Multiplayer only. When enabled, pressing Play on a device runs a short ready-check so every nearby player starts the song at the same moment (up to ~2 second delay before the music starts). When disabled (default), music starts almost immediately and listeners sync by joining the track mid-play.
Legacy spawn rate for cassette tapes (0-100000%). 0=Disabled, 100=Normal. Multiplies with legacy cassette pack rates.
Caps how many TrueMoozic media items of EACH type (cassettes, vinyl, CDs) can appear in a single freshly-looted container, leaving room for other loot. 0 = no cap.
Maximum real-world seconds a tape can play before timing out. Default 2100 (35 minutes).
Time between music state checks. Higher = better performance, slower updates.
Percent chance, when a player walks within 2 tiles of a base-game computer, that the Skype ringtone plays. Roll happens at most once per cooldown.
In-game days the same computer must wait before another chance roll, regardless of whether the previous roll succeeded.
Testing only. Bypasses chance roll and per-computer cooldown so the Skype ring plays whenever you stand near a computer.
Holiday easter egg: when enabled, walking near a base-game computer can occasionally play the Skype ringtone. Disable to silence the easter egg entirely.
If enabled, the TrueMoozic StepVan can spawn in vehicle parking zones. Disable to prevent it from spawning in the world.
Choose a starting TrueMoozic device & one random cassette.

Adds +1000 trunk capacity to step vans (160 -> 1160). Off = vanilla capacity everywhere. On = only the TrueMoozic StepVan. All = every step van variant (Mail, Cereal, etc.). Applies to newly spawned vehicles.
Enable periodic [TMSpeaker] debug logs for speaker sync and HiFi source detection.
Spawn rate for vinyl media items (records/albums) (0-100000%). 0=Disabled, 100=Normal.
Spawn rate for zombie walkman bundle (Walkman + Headphones + Cassette). 0=Disabled, 100=Normal. Default is around 1 in 100 zombies.
A bundle of speaker wire. Use to connect speakers to a music device (Vinyl Player or HiFi Stereo). <LINE> <LINE> Contains 200ft of wire. Each connection uses 5ft per tile of distance.

LEFT arrow key - Removes the cassette from the cassette player. UP arrow key - Toggles the cassette player ON/OFF. RIGHT arrow key - Toggles cassette player PLAY/STOP. Press the DOWN arrow key to insert a random cassette into the device.

Allow Device keys
You can use the keys for Walkmans and car radios.
Allows you to start with headphones or earbuds too.
Backpacks and fanny packs will be used when adding and removing cassettes, rather than the inventory.
The glove compartment will be used when adding or removing cassettes, rather than the equipment or inventory.
Allows you to start with a boombox.
Select your choice for leaving cassettes. If the specified place is not found they will be sent to inventory.
Let the music be with you... always.

The following options are for testing.
They work only if sandbox options are inactive.
*Caution* The location from which you want to send the cassettes. If the specified location is not found, nothing will happen.
Allows you to start with a vinyl player.
Allows you to start with your favorite portable player.

Adds a random cassette.
Only if you have one or more cassettes.
Removes the cassette from the cassette player.

Starts cassette playback.
If the cassette player doesn't have a cassette, it will automatically insert one.
Only if you have one or more cassettes.
